description: Known upstream advisories that cannot be resolved by npm audit fix. Every entry in "advisories" MUST include: package, advisory (GHSA/CVE id), severity, reason, owner, added (YYYY-MM-DD) and reviewBy (YYYY-MM-DD); optional scope. Exceptions are time-bounded: an entry whose reviewBy has passed fails the scheduled dependency audit (Issue #977) until it is re-reviewed. Never add an entry to silence a finding without review. Remove an entry when an upstream fix is released and the lockfile is updated.

resolved.reason: Resolved 2026-10-29 via npm audit fix. express-rate-limit updated to a version that no longer pulls the vulnerable ip-address.
